name: OpenAB Gateway
description: Standalone webhook gateway for openab — bridges Telegram / LINE / Feishu / Google Chat / MS Teams to an outbound-only openab pod over WebSocket. Builds the openab-gateway binary from the openab repo's gateway/ sub-crate.

version.description: openab version to build from. Use 'latest' for main, a semver like '0.7.6' (resolved to tag v0.7.6), or any git ref (branch/tag/SHA).

repoUrl.description: Git repository URL to clone openab from. Override to point at a fork (e.g. https://github.com/<you>/openab.git) when building an unmerged branch.

listenAddr.description: GATEWAY_LISTEN value — the address openab-gateway binds to.

autostart.description: Start openab-gateway automatically via supervisor when the container boots. Requires at least one platform credential in env (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, FEISHU_APP_ID, GOOGLE_CHAT_ENABLED=true, LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET, ...).
